title: Compound growth, worked
author: Proofline
dek: A three-line worked example, written for this app to show what the Explore model does. It is an illustration, not a reading.

runs.text: Take one hundred units and add a tenth of whatever is there at each step. After one step there are one hundred and ten units; after two, one hundred and twenty-one. The rate never changes, and nothing new is ever put in.

Because each step is a tenth of the whole, the amount added grows as the total grows: the first step adds ten units, the second adds eleven. That is the whole of the idea, and it is arithmetic anyone can check by hand.

This page is a toy. It carries no evidence about the world and no one else's argument. Select the first paragraph and choose More, then Explore this idea: the model there runs the same rule on any starting amount, rate and number of steps you set, and says plainly what it assumed.
